title: Review the renewed GitHub SOC 2 report's scope, opinion, exceptions and customer-side controls
description: Read the report obtained in task 1 and write a review record against SEBI CSCRF GV.SC.S4 and RBI Outsourcing Directions 2025 para 79. The record covers: (a) the auditor's opinion is unqualified; (b) the systems in scope cover source hosting, GitHub Actions and GitHub Packages; (c) every exception in the testing results has a stated impact on example-co; (d) each customer-side control (CUEC) is mapped to an example-co control owner, for example SSO/MFA enforcement, branch protection and Actions secrets handling, with the CTO's input on the engineering items; (e) the subprocessor carve-outs match the subcontractors listed in vendors/github.json. For a bridge letter, record that it is interim and set a follow-up date for the full report.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed review record in the GRC store states the opinion type, report period, in-scope services and the exception count
Every CUEC listed in the report appears in the review record with a named example-co owner and a status (in place or gap)
Any exception or CUEC marked as a gap has a follow-up item recorded with an owner

verificationMethod.description: The CISO checks the review record against the report: the opinion, period and exception count match the report pages; the number of CUEC rows equals the number of CUECs in the report; and every row names an owner from details.json contacts or engineering. Expected result: no unreviewed exception or CUEC.

rootCause.description: Relying on a provider's SOC 2 report without reviewing its exceptions and customer-side controls leaves the para 79 assurance duty unmet. The expiring entry records exceptionsCount 0 but no CUEC review.
